verdict.rationale: Square publishes an official TypeScript SDK under the square GitHub org, with a usage example (client.payments.create). It also ships a native Mobile Payments SDK for iOS/Android, and its API-spec README steers developers to pre-built clients in their language of choice. Its llms.txt describes the platform as 'Square APIs and SDKs'. missing for 10: concrete evidence of the full set of server-side language SDKs beyond TypeScript, independent or hands-on corroboration of SDK quality.
